# Fix-It Saturday, 13 March

Millbrook Library, Room B · 10am to 1pm

**60 seats, just turn up!** Room B is on the first floor and is step-free via the lift next to the children's library.

Bring your broken item and its charger. We can't take microwaves, gas appliances or damaged batteries.

Free. Tea only this time.

Questions? Text Priya on 555-0187 or call the library on 555-0100.
